subject: VOLUNTARY RIGHTS ISSUE: Apex Renewables PLC (ISIN: GB00B1YW4409) - Subscription Cutoff Approaching
body:
ATTENTION: CORPORATE ACTIONS TRADING DESK

Event Type: Voluntary Rights Offering (RHTS)
Security: APEX RENEWABLES PLC ORD 10P (GB00B1YW4409)
Rights Security ISIN: GB00B88K3391 (Apex Renewables Nil-Paid Rights)

Ratio: 1 new ordinary share for every 4 existing shares held
Subscription Price: 420.00 GBX per new ordinary share

Key Deadlines:
- Rights Trading Expiry: 05-OCT-2026 12:00 BST
- Custodian Election Deadline: 06-OCT-2026 15:00 BST

Options:
Option 1: Subscribe in full (exercise rights at 420p per share)
Option 2: Apply for excess shares (subject to scaling)
Option 3: Sell rights in the market before trading closes
Option 4: Lapse / No action (Rights will lapse worthless)

Action Required: Urgent instruction required from portfolio managers. Kindly confirm funds availability in settlement account for total subscription consideration.
